shared_elements: repeated parallel lines or band-like marks
justification: The most specific common content is the presence of schematic anthropomorphic forms together with circular/disc-like motifs and repeated linear bands. The biggest difference is that A is dominated by a single frontal body-like figure with internal motifs, while B is a dispersed field of profile animals, boats, rows of marks, and small stick figures with no comparable central figure or iconographic arrangement.
